The Software Map

Every screen, every modal and drawer, every interface endpoint, every backend file, every database table and every schema in the system, and how each one connects to the next. Read out of the source code, then checked table by table against the live production database. Search anything below.

Built from commit 5ee312cf0 · September 2, 2026

How this was built, and what it does not cover. Screens come from the route file, resolved through the lazy imports to a real source file, so every route here names the file that renders it. Modals, endpoints and the file-to-table mapping come from reading the backend and frontend source. Database status was checked against the live production database on the date above, not inferred from the code. Forty-eight entries the extractor originally produced were dropped after checking, because they were SQL table aliases and JavaScript identifiers rather than real tables; they are not counted anywhere on this page. The click path runs downward: a screen opens a modal, the modal calls an endpoint, the endpoint lives in a backend file, and that file touches database tables. Anything in amber or red is an open end, not an error in the map. This map is only as current as the commit named at the top.
